Helpers of the Tensor Stencil

Source: R/tensor.R
fd_tensor_helpers.Rd

These are internal functions of fd_tensor(). tensor_plan() returns the plan of a request from the session's cache, computing it in C++ on the first call with that key. is_whole() tests for a single finite whole number. counts_of_order() returns the multi-indices of one total order as rows of counts, in the order of tuple_indices(). as_counts() validates a matrix of multi-indices and stores it as integers. as_columns() turns the value of a source function into a list of double vectors, one per declared multi-index.

Usage

tensor_plan(key, comp, kidx, accuracy)

is_whole(x)

counts_of_order(p, k)

as_counts(m, p, what)

as_columns(v, k, src)

Arguments

key

A string identifying the request: the accuracy, the number of coordinates, the components and the declarations.

comp, m

An integer matrix of counts, one row per multi-index.

kidx

A list of such matrices, of which the first is the function's own zero row.

accuracy

The order of accuracy of the stencils.

x

A value to test.

p, k

The number of coordinates and a total order; in as_columns(), k is the number of declared multi-indices.

what

The argument name used in an error message.

v

The value returned by a source function.

src

The position of the source: 1 for f, \(j + 1\) for known[[j]].

Value

tensor_plan() a list of the plan's vectors and matrices; is_whole() a single logical; counts_of_order() and as_counts() an integer matrix; as_columns() a list of double vectors.
